# ConsolationClient

`premake5.lua`, `generate.bat`, `generate-linux.sh`, `src/`, and `src_xlive/` define the Windows x86 Consolation Client build, runtime DLLs, offline LIVE shim, and game integration for *007: Quantum of Solace* multiplayer.

## Contents

- [Directory.Build.props](./Directory.Build.props) configures `ClCompile` include paths and warning disables.
- [premake5.lua](./premake5.lua) defines Premake projects, dependency loading, Git version generation, and build options.
- [generate.bat](./generate.bat) synchronizes submodules, verifies or downloads Premake `v5.0.0-beta8`, and generates `build\consolation-client.sln`.
- [generate-nightly.bat](./generate-nightly.bat) forwards `%*` to `generate.bat`.
- [generate-linux.sh](./generate-linux.sh) bootstraps Wine, MSVC-Wine, Premake, and x86 MSBuild before compiling the solution.
- [fixdeps.sh](./fixdeps.sh) reconstructs Git submodules from `.gitmodules`.
- [README.md](./README.md) documents supported game version `1.1`, installation, launch, nightly builds, and project credits.
- [LICENSE](./LICENSE) defines CC BY-NC 4.0 restrictions for ujicos’s 2026 work.

## Subdirectories

- [.agents-reverse-engineer/](./.agents-reverse-engineer/) contains `config.yaml` and `GENERATION-PLAN.md` for documentation generation.
- [required_files/](./required_files/) contains [README.txt](./required_files/README.txt) with Patch 1.1 and `Launch Consolation.lnk` requirements.
- [src/](./src/) contains `DllMain()`, `main()`, proxy-library forwarding, component loading, game bindings, exceptions, and utilities.
- [src_xlive/](./src_xlive/) contains `xlive_shim.cpp`, `xlive.def`, and offline Windows LIVE compatibility behavior.

## Build and Architecture

`premake5.lua` creates the `consolation-client` workspace with `d3d9` and `xlive` shared-library projects targeting x86/Win32, C++20, `v143`, and the latest Windows SDK.

`d3d9` compiles `src/**` with `std_include.hpp` precompiled headers, while `xlive` compiles `src_xlive/**` and exports the ABI defined by `xlive.def`.

`generate-buildinfo` derives `GIT_DESCRIBE`, `GIT_HASH`, `GIT_BRANCH`, `VERSION_PRODUCT`, `VERSION_BUILD`, and related values into `src/version.h`, `src/version.hpp`, and `version.txt`.

`dependencies.load()`, `dependencies.imports()`, and `dependencies.projects()` load dependency scripts under `./deps/premake/*.lua`, attach imports to `d3d9`, and add dependency projects.

`main()` validates the multiplayer installation, invokes `component_loader::post_start()` and `component_loader::post_load()`, and initializes runtime components under `src/component/`.

## Configuration and Workflow

`generate.bat` selects `PREMAKE_BIN` by preferring global `premake5.exe`, then hash-verified `tools\premake5.exe`, then the pinned `PREMAKE_URL`.

`generate-linux.sh` accepts `--yes`, `--clean`, `--no-deps`, `--no-submodules`, `--force`, `--verbose`, directory overrides, timeout overrides, and `debug|Debug` or `release|Release`.

`generate-linux.sh` runs `sync_submodules`, `gen_vscode`, `gen_bbuild`, `compile`, and `print_summary` on the fast path, with `compile()` targeting `build/consolation-client.sln` and `Platform=Win32`.

`Debug` enables `DEBUG` and `_DEBUG`, while `Release` enables `NDEBUG`, `/Os`, `FatalCompileWarnings`, and `LinkTimeOptimization`.

`clean=true` invokes destructive `rm -rf`, and `prompt()` gates `build()` and `bootstrap()` unless `--yes` is supplied.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `PREMAKE_HASH` equals `2301e3e23ff3074cb83a5ea6103d68c7ea81dad56b786807c84b0643cddea31b`.
- `getbaseversion()` defaults invalid, empty, or `nil` tags to `"0.0.1"`.
- `gitVersioningCommand` equals `"git describe --tags --dirty --always"`.
- `generate-buildinfo` recognizes `#define GIT_DESCRIBE (.+)%s*$`, `#define VERSION_PRODUCT \"([^\"]*)\"%s*$`, and `#define VERSION_BUILD \"([^\"]*)\"%s*$`.
- `local_offline_mode_requested()` recognizes `offline`, `local_offline`, and `local-offline`.
- `has_supported_multiplayer_marker()` requires case-insensitive equality with `"multiplayer"` at RVA `0x0050502C`.

- `offline_xuid()` uses `1469598103934665603ull`, `1099511628211ull`, and `0x1100001000000000ull | (hash & 0x0000FFFFFFFFFFFFull)`.

## Installation Constraints

`README.md` requires English/French `1.1`, the default `C:\Program Files (x86)\Activision\Quantum of Solace(TM)\` path, copied release files, and `JB_Launcher_s.exe -multiplayer`.

`README.md` excludes repacks, other regions, unpatched `1.0`, unsupported game versions, and non-multiplayer launches.

`LICENSE` prohibits commercial use, sales, paid software, revenue-generating services, SaaS, and hosting.

`xlive_shim.cpp` implements an offline Windows LIVE compatibility layer, while `xlive.def` preserves the exported `xlive` ABI and `README.md` documents storage and profile-import behavior.

## Contents

- [README.md](./README.md) documents `storage/profiles`, `title_storage`, `41560829.gpd`, deterministic XUID generation, and `name`-based profile selection.
- [xlive.def](./xlive.def) maps `xlive_X*` exports to fixed ordinals with `NONAME`.
- [xlive_shim.cpp](./xlive_shim.cpp) implements Winsock forwarding, offline identity, profile settings, title storage, session stubs, UI stubs, and overlapped operations.

## Architecture

`xlive_shim.cpp` resolves identity through `offline_name()` and `offline_xuid()`, persists settings through `storage_root()`, `offline_profile_root()`, and `profile_setting_path()`, and maps title-storage requests through `title_storage_path()`.

`xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` imports legacy `41560829.gpd` data through `import_legacy_qos_profile()`, serializes values through `serialize_profile_value()`, and returns packed `xuser_read_profile_setting_result` data.

`xlive_XStorageUploadFromMemory()` and `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` exchange binary payloads through `read_file()`, `write_file()`, and `title_storage_path()`.

`complete_overlapped()`, `finish_operation()`, `inert_success()`, and `inert_not_found()` coordinate `xoverlapped` completion, Win32 events, callbacks, and observable error codes.

## ABI Surface

`xlive.def` exports networking, XNet, notification, rendering, protected-data, UI, user, profile, statistics, session, and title-storage symbols with stable ordinals.

`xlive_XWSAStartup()`, `xlive_XSocketCreate()`, `xlive_XSocketClose()`, `xlive_XSocketIOCTLSocket()`, `xlive_XSocketSetSockOpt()`, `xlive_XSocketBind()`, `xlive_XSocketRecvFrom()`, `xlive_XSocketSendTo()`, `xlive_XSocketInet_Addr()`, `xlive_XWSAGetLastError()`, and `xlive_XSocketHTONS()` forward to Winsock.

`xlive_XUserGetXUID()`, `xlive_XUserGetName()`, `xlive_XUserGetSigninInfo()`, `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()`, and `xlive_XUserWriteProfileSettings()` implement deterministic offline user and profile behavior for user index `0`.

`xlive_XSessionCreate()`, `xlive_XSessionDelete()`, `xlive_XSessionMigrateHost()`, and related `xlive_XSession*()` functions create, update, and complete offline session operations.

`xlive_XStorageBuildServerPath()`, `xlive_XStorageUploadFromMemory()`, and `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` implement the `offline://<facility>/<sanitized-item>` title-storage contract.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `offline_xuid()` uses FNV-1a constants `1469598103934665603ull` and `1099511628211ull`, then applies `0x1100001000000000ull | (hash & 0x0000FFFFFFFFFFFFull)`.
- `offline_name()` checks the `name` dvar, command-line `name`, `+name`, `-name`, `-set name value`, and `-seta name value`, then falls back to `"Player"`.
- `qos_module()` uses `qos_base = 0x10000000`, `dvar_hash_table_addr = 0x1149FCE0`, and `generate_hash_value_addr = 0x10275260`.
- `title_storage_path()` strips case-insensitive `offline://`, splits the first `/`, defaults facility to `"3"`, and calls `sanitize_storage_name()`.
- `sanitize_storage_name()` replaces control characters and `<>:"/\\|?*` with `_`, and maps empty, `"."`, and `".."` to `"unnamed"`.
- `import_legacy_qos_profile()` validates little-endian `FBDX`/XDBF tables and imports namespace-3 settings only when destination files are absent.
- `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` returns `0x8015C004` for missing files, `0x8015C003` for oversized files, and copies `bytes_total`, `xuid_owner`, and `created` metadata.
- `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` returns `ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER` with the required size, emits null settings for missing files, and supports `xuser_data` tags `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, and `0xFF`.
- `xlive_XEnumerate()`, `xlive_XUserCreateStatsEnumeratorByRank()`, `xlive_XUserCreateStatsEnumeratorByXuid()`, and `xlive_XFriendsCreateEnumerator()` use `ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES` for empty enumerations.
- `xlive_XNotifyGetNext()` returns `0`, `xlive_XNetGetConnectStatus()` returns `1`, `xlive_XOnlineGetNatType()` returns `1`, and `xlive_XNetGetEthernetLinkStatus()` returns `1`.

## Integration Constraints

`xlive.def` ordinal stability and `NONAME` declarations are ABI-critical for consumers of `xlive`.

`xlive_shim.cpp` requires Windows headers, Winsock2, `shellapi`, filesystem support, and 64-bit-compatible layouts for `XUID`, `xoverlapped`, `xsession_info`, `xstorage_download_results`, `xuser_data`, `xuser_profile_setting`, `xuser_read_profile_setting_result`, and `xuser_signin_info`.

`xlive_XUserWriteProfileSettings()` always writes under `qos_title_id = 0x41560829`, while `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` uses `qos_title_id` only when `title_id == 0`.

`xlive_XSessionCreate()` owns event handles consumed by `xlive_XSessionDelete()`, and `xlive_XNotifyCreateListener()` creates an auto-reset event requiring lifecycle cleanup.

`xoverlapped` operations complete immediately, but APIs with an `xoverlapped` argument may return `ERROR_IO_PENDING`; callers should inspect `xlive_XGetOverlappedResult()` or `xlive_XGetOverlappedExtendedError()`.

	game::dvar_s* replace_dvar(const dvar_spec& spec, const bool log)
	{
		const auto value_string = dvar_value_to_string(spec);
		auto* const existing = game::Dvar_FindVar(spec.name);
		if (existing)
		{
			switch (spec.type)
			{
			case game::DVAR_TYPE_BOOL:
				existing->current.enabled = spec.value.enabled;
				existing->latched.enabled = spec.value.enabled;
				existing->reset.enabled = spec.value.enabled;
				break;

			case game::DVAR_TYPE_INT:
				existing->current.integer = spec.value.integer;
				existing->latched.integer = spec.value.integer;
				existing->reset.integer = spec.value.integer;
				break;

			case game::DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT:
				existing->current.value = spec.value.value;
				existing->latched.value = spec.value.value;
				existing->reset.value = spec.value.value;
				break;

			case game::DVAR_TYPE_STRING:
				existing->current.string = spec.value.string;
				existing->latched.string = spec.value.string;
				existing->reset.string = spec.value.string;
				break;

			default:
				break;
			}

			existing->domain = spec.domain;
			existing->modified = true;
			set_saved_dvar_flags(existing, spec.flags);
			if (log)
			{
				console::debug("overriding %s dvar '%s' with %s\n", dvar_type_name(spec.type), spec.name, value_string.c_str());
			}
			return existing;
		}

		switch (spec.type)
		{
		case game::DVAR_TYPE_BOOL:
			if (log)
			{
				console::debug("registered %s dvar '%s' = %s\n", dvar_type_name(spec.type), spec.name, value_string.c_str());

			if (log)

				console::debug("registered %s dvar '%s' = %s\n", dvar_type_name(spec.type), spec.name, value_string.c_str());
			}
			return Dvar_RegisterFloat(spec.name, spec.description, spec.value.value, spec.domain.value.min, spec.domain.value.max, spec.flags);

		case game::DVAR_TYPE_STRING:
			if (log)
			{
				console::debug("registered %s dvar '%s' = %s\n", dvar_type_name(spec.type), spec.name, value_string.c_str());

			return Dvar_RegisterString(spec.name, spec.value.string ? spec.value.string : "", spec.description, spec.flags);

		default:

		}
	}

	game::dvar_s* replace_dvar_at(const std::uintptr_t nop_address, const std::size_t nop_size, game::dvar_s** target, const dvar_spec& spec, const bool log)
	{
		utils::hook::nop(nop_address, nop_size);
		auto* const existing = game::Dvar_FindVar(spec.name);
		if (existing)
		{
			existing->domain = spec.domain;
			set_saved_dvar_flags(existing, spec.flags);
			if (target)
			{
				*target = existing;
			}

			if (log)
			{
				console::debug("reusing %s dvar '%s' with preserved value\n", dvar_type_name(spec.type), spec.name);
			}

			return existing;
		}

		auto* const dvar = register_dvar(spec, log);
		if (target)
		{
			*target = dvar;
		}

		return dvar;
	}
